svg.aria-label: A window for Sebastien Kawada. Zeros of a random polynomial fly in and settle on the unit circle, which becomes the equator of a spinning ASCII Riemann sphere; below it, embeddings coloured by cluster spiral into a glowing vortex. About: Interested in mathematics, multi-omics, machine learning. Elsewhere: kawada@mit.edu · github.com/chreia.
